pages.lesson:
LESSON: BASIC CHANTS/MANTRAS AS PER BUDDHISM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 4.1: Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how to apply pancha sila in real life. How is recitation of chants/ mantras important in Buddhist occasions?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment
2. describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth
3. appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BASIC CHANTS/MANTRAS AS PER BUDDHISM
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BASIC CHANTS/MANTRAS AS PER BUDDHISM
Study Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment

What this means
In this part you learn to identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism in your own words. (skill: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment.
3. Practise this skill: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate pancha sila (five precepts) for moral development.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to apply pancha sila in real life. How is recitation of chants/ mantras important in Buddhist occasions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify basic chants/the mantras of paying homage to the Buddha for spiritual nourishment.
5. Be able to: describe the importance of tisarana (taking refuge in triple gem) for spiritual growth.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
